scope: Non-test Echo HTTP registration expressions in core/http/routes plus cross-service/static registrations in core/http/app.go.
limitations: Group prefixes and globally applied middleware remain defined by source registrars and core/http/app.go; path_expression is registration-local.
POST can be inference or mutation; operation semantics remain handler-defined.

registrations.registration_expression: router.POST("/models/import-uri", localai.ImportModelURIEndpoint(cl, appConfig, galleryService, opcache), adminMiddleware)
router.POST("/models/edit/:name", localai.EditModelEndpoint(cl, ml, galleryService, appConfig), adminMiddleware)
node.POST("/register", localai.RegisterNodeEndpoint(registry, registrationToken, autoApprove, authDB, hmacSecret, natsCfg))
